headline: Partner Comparison, from entry to detail
overview: Partner Comparison lets you and your partner compare your Fierce Intimacy assessment results side by side. It surfaces where your intimacy styles, attachment patterns, and relational needs align or diverge, making it easier to have honest conversations about your connection and what each of you needs to feel truly seen and close.
targetAudience: Users interested in relationships tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Partner Comparison — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the initial state and main interface, with options to share your results and view a side-by-side comparison with your partner.
steps.screenshotAlt: Partner Comparison landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Side-by-side comparison of Fierce Intimacy results between partners
Highlights alignment and divergence across intimacy dimensions
Shareable link to invite your partner to complete the assessment
Conversation starters based on your comparison to facilitate deeper dialogue
tips: Both partners should complete the Fierce Intimacy assessment independently before comparing results
Use the comparison as a conversation tool, not a scorecard — differences are opportunities to understand each other better
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
